---
name: Measure before fixing
description: A quality change without a measurement is a guess dressed as work
scope: global
type: concept
---

Do not change something for quality without an instrument that would show the
change failing. The instrument comes first, and the case that fails goes into it
before the fix, not after.

## Why it generalises
This applies to code, to writing and to process. The shape is always the same: if
you cannot say what number moves, you cannot say the change worked.
